answer: The ripple edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 77 clones produces a signature the nectar analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the quill settlement applies the void retroactively.
